description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Texans signed CB Bryce Hall.
items.impact: Hall worked out for the Texans this month. He'll compete for a depth role in their secondary.
items.title: Bryce Hall signs with Texans

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Eagles released OL. Hollin Pierce.
items.impact: Pierce will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.
items.title: Hollin Pierce released by Eagles

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Eagles signed CB Isaiah Bolden.
items.impact: Bolden will compete for a depth role in the Eagles secondary.
items.title: Isaiah Bolden signs with Eagles

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Falcons released punter Matthew Hayball.
items.impact: Hayball will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.
items.title: Matthew Hayball released by Falcons

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Falcons released OL Layden Robinson.
items.impact: Robinson will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.
items.title: Layden Robinson released by Falcons

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Titans signed CB Corey Mayfield Jr.
items.impact: Mayfield will compete for a depth role in the Titans corner back room.
items.title: Corey Mayfield Jr. signs with Titans

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Titans waived/injured rookie LB Sean Brown.
items.impact: Brown will figure to seek another opportunity when he is cleared.
items.title: Sean Brown waived by Titans

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Panthers waived LB Nick Hampton with an injury settlement.
items.impact: Hampton will figure to seek another opportunity when he is cleared.
items.title: Nick Hampton waived by Panthers

items.desc: The Panthers waived OL Joshua Gray.
items.impact: Gray will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Rams signed punter Jack Bouwmeester.
items.impact: Bouwmeester will compete to be the Rams starting punter.
items.title: Jack Bouwmeester signs with Rams

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bears signed CB De'Antre Prince.
items.impact: Prince will compete for a depth role in the corner back room for Chicago.
items.title: De'Antre Prince signs with Bears

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Titans coach Robert Saleh said Mitch Trubisky is being evaluated for a biceps injury.
items.impact: Trubisky is day-to-day for now. There should be an update on his status later this week.
items.title: Mitchell Trubisky being evaluated for bicep injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Carson Schwesinger missed practice on Monday.
items.impact: Schwesinger remains hopeful to return to practice later this week.
items.title: Carson Schwesinger does not practice Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Cedric Tillman did not practice on Monday.
items.impact: Tillman is competing for a depth role in the Browns wide receiver room when he is healthy.
items.title: Cedric Tillman misses practice Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Michael Coats Jr. was back at practice on Monday.
items.impact: Coats had left early on Saturday. He signed with Cleveland back in May.
items.title: Michael Coats Jr. (ankle) returns to practice Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Seahawks signed RB Anthony Hankerson.
items.impact: Hankerson will compete for a depth role in the running back room for Seattle.
items.title: Anthony Hankerson signs with Seahawks

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Seahawks signed WR Julian Hicks.
items.impact: Hicks will compete for a depth role in the wide receiver room for Seattle.
items.title: Julian Hicks signs with Seahawks

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Seahawks signed LB Power Echols.
items.impact: Echols returns to the Seahawks organization where he'll compete for a depth role.
items.title: Power Echols signs with Seahawks

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Seahawks waived RB Justin Jones.
items.impact: Jones will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.
items.title: Justin Jones waived by Seahawks

items.impact: Harden will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.
items.title: TJ Harden waived by Seahawks

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Seahawks placed CB Shemar Jean-Charles on injured reserve.
items.impact: Jean-Charles is likely to miss the upcoming season.
items.title: Shemar Jean-Charles placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Rams coach Sean McVay said OL Keagen Trost likely miss a few weeks with a hamstring injury.
items.impact: Trost started at RT in the preseason opener. This timeline puts him close to the season opener.
items.title: Keagen Trost (hamstring) to miss a few weeks

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Atlanta Falcons have released WR Kristian Wilkerson.
items.impact: Wilkerson will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.
items.title: Kristian Wilkerson released by Falcons

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: James Pearce Jr. will play in the preseason.
items.impact: Pearce is eligible to play before he begins to serve his eight-game suspension during the season.
items.title: James Pearce Jr. will play in preseason

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Dolphins waived Tanner Wall.
items.impact: Wall had signed with Miami earlier in August. He'll figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.
items.title: Tanner Wall waived by Dolphins
